name: Nightmare Sunder (Combat, Technique)
body:
Your foe’s defenses are useless against your unrelenting sword.

Prerequisite(s): Str 13, weapon proficiency in a weapon from the heavy blades weapon group, base attack bonus +4

Benefit(s): When you charge, your sunder attempts do not provoke an attack of opportunity. A creature wielding a weapon you successfully damage with a sunder attempt using a heavy blade on a charge takes a -2 penalty to AC until the end of your next turn.
